tools.name: list_esim_destinations
tools.description: Countries and regions Slashtel sells travel eSIMs for, with the lowest live price (USD) and number of plans. Optional search text filters by name.

tools.name: get_esim_plans
tools.description: Live travel eSIM plans for one destination: data (GB), validity (days), price (USD) and price per GB. Use an ISO-2 country code (e.g. TR, JP, US, GB) or a destination code from list_esim_destinations. Optional filters narrow the list.

tools.name: get_topup_plans
tools.description: Detects the operator of a mobile number and returns the live top-up options for it: what the recipient receives, validity where it applies, and the price in USD. The number must include the country code, e.g. +911234567890.

tools.name: create_checkout_link
tools.description: Returns a slashtel.com link with the chosen eSIM plan or top-up already selected. Share it with the user: they enter their email and pay on the site. For type 'esim' pass plan_id. For type 'topup' pass phone, operator_code and send_value from get_topup_plans.
